title: Menger's criterion for $k$-connectivity
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$, and let $k$ be a natural number with $|V| \ge k+1$. Then $\kappa(G) \ge k$ if and only if every pair of distinct vertices $u, v$ of $G$ is joined by at least $k$ internally disjoint $u$–$v$ paths.
hypotheses_covered: G is a simple graph on a finite vertex set
biconditional: k ≤ κ(G) iff every distinct pair has at least k internally disjoint paths
